Home Highlights
- Brand New Construction
- Private Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional ( ) per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
- Elevator
- 6 Seater Golf Cart Included
- 6 Adult Bicycles Included
- Outdoor Fireplace
- Convenient Beach Access

Experience coastal living at its best in this brand-new beach rental, thoughtfully designed for relaxed luxury and effortless vacation living. Perfectly located close to several popular beach towns, the home offers easy access to local dining, boutique shopping, coffee spots, and scenic coastal paths, making it an ideal home base for exploring the area.

The property features a private pool and spa, perfect for sunny days and unwinding after time at the beach. Evenings can be spent gathered around the outdoor fireplace, creating a cozy setting for conversation and relaxation. With convenient beach access just moments away, you’ll enjoy quick trips to the sand and water without the hassle.

Inside, the home showcases modern finishes, open-concept living spaces, and an elevator that provides easy access to all levels which is ideal for guests of all ages. To enhance your stay, a 6-seater golf cart and 6 adult bicycles are included, allowing you to easily cruise the neighborhood, explore nearby beach towns, or head out for a sunset ride.

Whether you’re planning a family vacation, a group getaway, or a laid-back coastal retreat, this home combines new construction comfort with resort-style amenities and an unbeatable location near the best of the beach lifestyle.
